keyboard_guard.doc: A pad block line given as {keyboard_key, line} is a game button's keyboard alternate. On Linux, where Steam types Semu's chords into the game, it is left out when a config/input chord ends on that key (keyboard_key spelt as the chords spell keys), because PCSX2 2.6.3 registers pad buttons as axis handlers that fire on every key event whatever the modifiers (InputManager.cpp:880-891, 1118-1122): Ctrl+A would also press Square. macOS keeps them, as RetroArch keeps its player keys there.

doc.purpose: PCSX2 profile tree content (config/inis/PCSX2.ini plus config/inputprofiles/Steam Deck.ini) as data, substituted by Pcsx2Emitter. Variables: ${pad} is the packaged platform's first SDL gamepad identity, ${bios_directory} the resolved read-only firmware folder, ${renderer_key}/${renderer_value} the contract's required OpenGL setting, ${emulator_name} the contract name.
doc.grammar: PCSX2's ini wire format: one '<device>/<control>' binding per line (SDL3 setting names: FaceSouth/FaceEast/FaceWest/FaceNorth by position; the SDL2 names A/B/X/Y are migrated only while that pad is already connected, so at startup PCSX2 rejects them), an alternative ('Keyboard/<key>') as the same key repeated on the next line (PCSX2 reads repeated keys as a list and rejects ' | ' as an invalid binding), 'Keyboard/Control & Keyboard/P' hotkey chords (translated by Pcsx2Emitter from the keymap).
doc.menu: ui.menu is Semu's alone: OpenPauseMenu is not bound, or the radial's Ctrl+M would open PCSX2's pause menu under Semu's and the menu's pause would then unpause it.
doc.hotkeys: The keymap is written into PCSX2.ini [Hotkeys], the only hotkeys PCSX2 reads without a per-game input profile, and into the Steam Deck input profile as well. Seen in the podman VM 2026-10-03: with the hotkeys only in the profile, Ctrl+P and Ctrl+S did nothing in PCSX2 2.6.3.
doc.keyboard: Keyboard/Enter is Qt's keypad Enter (QtKeyCodes.cpp:75-76; the main key is Return), so Start keeps it everywhere. Ctrl++ is written Keyboard/NumpadPlus: Steam types its + as KEYPAD_PLUS, which Qt reports as Key_Plus with the keypad modifier, named NumpadPlus (QtKeyCodes.cpp:514-517, 540-541, 595); main-row Plus would never match.
doc.players: One [PadN] per player (for_each players): player 1 keeps the keyboard alternates; player 2 reads only the SDL pad it holds (${pcsx2_pad}, SDL-<roster index>, PCSX2's order of opened pads), and a player without a pad is Type = None.
doc.picture: filter = 2 is Bilinear (PS2), upstream's default: textures filter as the game asks the GS to (0, Nearest, broke games that rely on it and drew PCSX2's Texture filtering is not set to Bilinear (PS2) notice over the composed TV at every boot). WarnAboutUnsafeSettings = false keeps PCSX2's unsafe-settings notice (integer scaling, the forced OpenGL renderer) off the composed frame (VMManager.cpp:3156-3290 at v2.6.3). OsdMessagesPos = 0 (OsdOverlayPos::None) drops every other OSD message before it is drawn (ImGuiManager.cpp:702 at v2.6.3), such as 'Controller SDL-0 connected.' at boot, seen over the TV in the Deck's frame-60 capture on 2026-10-05; Semu's own toasts announce saves, loads and choices. The render hook (semu_render_hook.patch) draws the GS output at its own size, one texel to one pixel, and publishes that for Semu's renderer to scale by whole steps and shade; upscale_multiplier is the system's render scale (visual.systems.ps2.render_scale, 1x by default, so one GS texel is one game pixel), and above 1x the published texel size is the scaled picture, which the renderer divides back to native; IntegerScaling and AspectRatio give only the picture's shape there and PCSX2's own picture when Semu composes nothing.

native_shortcuts.why: PCSX2 binds hotkeys from PCSX2.ini [Hotkeys]: an input profile, and with it UseProfileHotkeyBindings, is applied only through a per-game settings ini naming it (UpdateGameSettingsLayer reads EmuCore.InputProfileName from the game layer alone), so the [EmuCore] InputProfileName in PCSX2.ini loads nothing and the profile's [Hotkeys] are written for per-game use only. A hotkey PCSX2.ini leaves out stays unbound (AddHotkeyBindings skips empty lists), and Pad::SetDefaultHotkeyConfig (SIO/Pad/Pad.cpp:216-262, which also puts Toggle Pause on Space and Toggle Turbo on Tab) runs only when settings are reset, which SettingsVersion = 1 prevents; its defaults would put Zoom In and Zoom Out on Ctrl+Plus and Ctrl+Minus (Semu's fast forward and rewind) and the pause menu on Escape.
native_shortcuts.superset_source: pcsx2 bc8151d pcsx2/Input/InputManager.cpp:1080-1170: a chord binding fires whenever all of its keys are down, and only a longer bound chord cancels it, so Ctrl+A also fires on Ctrl+Shift+A
